settings.heading: Track Order
settings.lede: Find the status of an order or an exhibition test journey.
settings.notice: The current storefront is a gated exhibition. Checkout and order details may be examples.

settings.heading: Use the order email
settings.text: Open the order confirmation or shipping email for the order status link and any tracking number. A carrier link appears only when tracking has been added to that order.

settings.heading: Check your account
settings.text: If you used a customer account, sign in to Account and open the order. The order status page shows the latest information available to the store.

settings.heading: Need help finding it?
settings.text: Contact us with the order reference and email used for the order. Do not send payment card details. For an exhibition test order, mention that it is a test.
